info.name: Ovatify API
info.description:
Comprehensive Postman collection for the Ovatify application API.

Auth flow is fully scripted: hit each Auth request in order, OR use "Run Collection" on the Auth folder. The test scripts auto-capture OTPs, user_id, and tokens into collection variables, so you don't have to copy/paste anything between requests.

When APP_DEBUG=true on the backend, OTPs are returned in the response body (verification_code field). On prod with APP_DEBUG=false, OTPs only arrive via email.

exec: // Generate a fresh user per run so signup doesn't collide with previous runs.
console.log('Signup OK. user_id=' + body.user_id + ' otp=' + body.verification_code);
console.log('Fresh OTP from login re-issue: ' + body.verification_code);
pm.test('login w/ new pwd returns 200', () => pm.response.to.have.status(200));

item.name: Lookups
item.description: Reference data used by Flutter to populate filter chips, license picker, agreement template picker, and DSP platform picker.

item.name: Distribution
item.description: Track Distribution to DSPs (Spotify / YT Music / Tidal etc.). Submit a track for delivery, then poll status. Available to creators (own tracks) and consumers (tracks they've invested in).

item.name: Wallet
item.description: Lightweight wallet binding for crypto investments (MetaMask / WalletConnect). Stores the wallet address client-side SDK reports.

item.name: Creator Sessions (Upload / Create flow)
item.description: Drafts → ideas → customize → mix → arrange → finalize → publish. Backs the Figma 'Upload your own content' + 'Create a Session' pipeline.

item.name: AI Tools (Creative Workspace)
item.description: All 8 tools from the Figma Creative Workspace. Each POST returns an AiTask row with status (placeholder result for now — real provider integration is a TODO). Use GET tasks/{id} to poll.

item.name: Rights Management
item.description: Backs the Figma Rights tab — list creator's tracks (projects), CRUD collaborators with role + split %, view/edit agreement, upload custom agreement template.

item.name: Collab Requests
item.description: Backs the Figma Home → Collab Requests section. Send, accept, decline, withdraw.
